reply: I am known as Para Norbert.
My role here is quest giver.

It is the world of the dead. Many sages believe, that it is located below the world of the living. Yet some think, it lies within another dimension so that terms like above or beneath are inappropriate to describe it. ...
There are some rumours that the descent to the Netherworld is difficult yet possible for those still living.

I can also give you information on prizes and fees.","First thing to know: dying here will not cost you anything, except the fee you need to pay for each match. To us, its silence is forbidden. Only echoes of wrath linger there. ...

{"observations":[],"sources":[{"access_method":"EXISTING_COMMITTED_PUBLIC_API_SNAPSHOT_READ_OFFLINE","kind":"BR_WIKI_IDENTITY_SPEECH_FACTS","pointer":"/pages/604","revision":355556,"snapshot_sha256":"0773232ddd356be273474be7b3aea645ed5dbbf93e5832a94d565ad9e579657a","source_sha256":"fbaa7599a959ec427e123537226e6366f8fab4961ad2a5b3f46ea78a2e149b81","url":"https://www.tibiawiki.com.br/wiki/Smaralda"}],"unassigned_wiki_speech":["Welcome Jogador! Let us talk about fate.","Fate is a road that we all travel but rarely notice. Long ago I have bound my fate to that of a pirate whose name can't be spoken anymore. ...","I try to ease his gruesome fate with my abilities.","The good old captain was never one of the evil bandits of the seas but a gentleman robber who actually fought for freedom and against slavery. ...","Of all the things, good or bad he did in his life, the most fateful was a promise he made to his people to bring back a holy icon that other pirates had robbed while he was away. ...","He tracked the icon to the Mourning Isles but there he met his cruel fate and died without fulfilling his promise.","These isles seemed to be cursed by the gods even before the first living beings arrived there. Since then they've had a history of pain, treachery and desolation. But the lure of its treasures is still strong. ...","Many would try to brave the undead inhabitants of the isles to rob them of their treasure but there is no ship of the living that can still reach the isles.","No ordinary ship can hope to reach the legendary Mourning Isles. But there is one ship that could do it! It is the ship of the old pirate. ...","In these days he is looking for a crew of mortals to help him end his self-imposed curse.","The old pirate made a promise to return an icon from the Mourning Isles. A promise he could not fulfil. ...","Again and again he is looking for helpers that will allow him to summon his ship to this world and reach these cursed isles to finally find that icon. ...","You might be able to help him, but only after my soul seeing reveals which spirit mark will govern your life for the next cycle. ...","Even then you will have to find three others with the same spirit mark bound to them to provide the pirate with a strong and capable crew.","You are marked by the \"Seu Espiríto\".","There are spirits all around us. Some are close to the world of the living, some are far away. Some of them sympathize with our trials and sense some kind of familiarity to us. ...","These spirits attach themselves to us for a period of time when they feel that our fate corresponds with certain aspects of their own. I learned how to visualise those spirits and therefore can say a bit about the future that might await you. ...","Even more, I connected those spirits to a certain symbolism to make the concept more accessible. I learned that people that share the same symbols are somehow connected by fate. ...","We can use this fact to help the captain to find his crew. He needs people who are connected to each other to help him in his quest.","I am only known as Smaralda in these days.","My endeavours of the past are unimportant. I'm nothing but an old woman that sometimes dabbles with the mystic arts. ...","Now I'm just a fortuneteller and sometimes a helper of fate. And I know a few old stories.","I rarely use my gift in these days. I use it only to help the old pirate to find the rest that he deserves by finding a crew for his ship.","Of all stories that I could tell, there is only one that is of importance in these days. This is the story about the old pirate.","Now that you have captured enough of the spectral scum you may use my crystal ball to meet the captain. ...","But keep in mind that you need three others with the same soul mark to proceed.","This world was successful in xx journeys. 50 journeys are necessary to give the captain some peace for this month.","Good bye, Jogador."]}

I learned that people that share the same symbols are somehow connected by fate. ...","We can use this fact to help the captain to find his crew. A story perhaps?","Yes.. nature speaks, this whole continent has a voice and it screams for help when changes are about to happen, it senses danger and warns us of evil presences and changes of the world. ...","This land is alive and every event we participate in has an impact on its people and on the environment. ...","So be ready and aid the world in its time of need. You may be greatly rewarded.","WISDOM! Such a desirable thing, isn't it? You have come to the right place, I have much knowledge to share about the world you live in, more than you could ever imagine. ...","But not everyone was born to possess great wisdom, especially when they intend to use it as a tool of destruction. Like Ferumbras for example, who used his immense power to call upon great demons to lay havoc on the city of Thais.","The sword is known as the Sword of Fury. Is the legend true? Who knows.","Many have tried to wreak havoc and destruction on various cities over the years. In days past our cities were raided by hordes of orcs, but they were defeated in their attempts to conquer our capital cities by the brave adventurers of those times. ...","They carried with them strong unique sets of armor, specifically crafted for that war. ...","They were recovered by the warriors who defeated them; but those ancient pieces of armor are rarely seen these days.","Ahh so you like legends, do you? Here's another one. It is said that the ancient pharaohs who ruled Ankrahmun in days long past, were mummified and buried with their most precious belongings in tombs beneath the sands of the desert. ...","It is also said that they were buried with the pieces of an ancient magical helmet of great power. Legend holds that the pharaohs will not part from their treasures easily... even after death.","There are many treasures out there for adventurers like you to claim, child. If you are brave enough to descend into hell itself! ...","There are many tasks around the world for experienced adventurers like you on the journey to the very Pits of Inferno! But beware! You never know what horrors stand between you and your desires.","Do you want to know what horror is, young adventurer? Horror has a name in these lands... actually, seven names. ...","Apocalypse, Ashfalor, Bazir, Infernatil, Pumin, Tafariel and Verminor. The Ruthless Seven, seven archdemons under the command of a god.","Zathroth is the god that controls the Ruthless Seven and he is the God of Destruction, #N. He is the evil half of one of the elder god. The other half is Uman the Wise. ...","Together they are one. Interesting, isn't it? Thought so.","I do not have a proper name, for I am a child of nature. I was given the gift to communicate with ancient ethereal beings; that is where my name comes from: the 'Spirit Speaker'.","The gift that has been bestowed upon me is the ability to communicate with the spirits and other ethereal entities who are among us. ...","It helps me uncover important knowledge about our surroundings. Knowledge I then share with the people who visit this place to inspire them to explore the wonders this world has to offer.","Job? I am a spirit speaker and a traveller of these lands. I discover its mysteries and learn about its past... our past. ...","Now you may be wondering what I do with all that knowledge and the answer is simple - I share it.","Mysteries! This world is full of them; take for instance the mysterious creature who lurks in the jungles of Port Hope which is said to carry one of the rarest plants known to botany! ...","Or the tales of underwater kingdoms ruled by fish-like creatures. Or perhaps the legend surrounding a demonic tree on the Plains of Havoc. ...","Interesting, isn't it? And this is just a taste of what is out there for you to explore.","May the spirits guide you."]}

Welcome! You can ask me about your 'trust points'!","I am the shaman of Rascacoon.","I'm the diviner of the will of the great raccoon and keeper of wisdom.","This colony lived in peace for centuries, but this peace is now severely disrupted. The pirats became a constant threat and annoyance.","This colony is called Rascacoon. But our tribe originates from a far way rascoohan city with the name Washingstone.","When they were still known as Corym, there were only occasional clashes over loot and flotsam. But one day things changed.","It's only a place of mystery and legend. We have no contact since generations and its location was lost in time.","Our spies found out that the Corym retrieved an ancient book from a trunk in a shipwreck. It taught them about the ways of the pirates.","Their leaders were convinced that this was a description of the old and forgotten ways of their people and they adopted it.","They became the pirats that we know today. They became more organized and more aggressive.","Things escalated when they by chance discovered the explosiveness of the mold of one of their favourite cheeses.","They weaponized the mold and refined it to so called green powder to create devastating weapons.","For now they employ it to terrorize the seas and experiment with its power.","It's only a matter of time until they will come and use their weapons against us. Therefore they have to be stopped.","I fear they have yet to unleash the true destructive power of this weapon. For all what we know they keep experimenting and refining it, somewhere deep in their dens. ...","To disrupt those experiments might prove helpful.","We know many secrets and studied the pirats for a long time. Our knowledge will prove helpful in fighting them.","Before we share our knowledge you have to help us, to strengthen our position and secure our colony.","When we feel safe enough from their retribution, we can approve a strike to the heart of the pirats. Until then it will be your mission to assist our colony.","He is our creator and guide.","The mother of all gave birth to the gods. The gods immediately begun with the creation of the world, as this was their only purpose.","Their greatest accomplishment was the creation of the great raccoon. Of all of the gods creations only he was perfect and therefore he was unique.","But the great raccoon immediately felt an enormous loneliness, because all of creation had their peers to bond but the unique raccoon hadn't.","So after the gods were done with creation, the great raccoon stole the secret of life out of their trashcan and created us Rascoohans in his image.","The great raccoon looks over us and we live our life to his enjoyment.","When the gods moved on to create other world, the great raccoon stood behind and kept watching over us.","What king? We have no king or leader. We have to convince other to cooperate and don't order them.","Are you sure that you want to listen to rascoohan wisdom? It might shatter the perception of reality for the weak.","Fools rush in while the iron is still hot.","It's better to be poor and healthy than to throw stones from inside a glasshouse.","If a man fools you once, shame on him. But if you teach him how to fish, he'll probably won't bother you ever again.","Never pass on a free snack or an unsecured trashcan - which is basically the same.","Too many cooks are better than one.","The early bird gets the worm. But the worm got up even more early and what good did it do him?"]}
